# Rule: Returned double pointer lost const

_Canonical rule slug:_ `return-double-pointer-lost-const`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A function returning a pointer to pointer loses const below the first level -- binary-identical, but the new result no longer converts to the old type, so callers binding it to the old type no longer compile.
